evidence_items.finding: new client intake has fallen from 18 clients per year to 4 clients per year over two years — a decline of more than 75% in incoming new business
evidence_items.rationale: Collapsing new client intake is the primary demand generation failure signal. No must_identify vocabulary used.

evidence_items.finding: three of the five primary introduction sources for new clients have retired and have not been replaced with alternative relationships
evidence_items.rationale: Loss of introduction sources without replacement is the structural cause of intake decline. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: the practice has never implemented any marketing, advertising, or structured business development activity — all new client intake has historically come from word of mouth
evidence_items.rationale: Absence of any active demand generation activity is the structural vulnerability. No must_identify terms.

evidence_items.finding: two long-standing clients have departed in the same period, adding further revenue attrition to the declining new client intake
evidence_items.rationale: Client attrition compounds the intake decline. Not primary driver but additive pressure.

evidence_items.finding: three-accountant practice; annual revenue $480K; new clients this year 4 versus 18 two years ago; existing client retention 91%; three accountants currently at capacity with existing workload
evidence_items.rationale: Structured summary. New client intake volume documented. No must_identify vocabulary.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): existing client retention rate is 91% and satisfaction feedback is positive
evidence_items.rationale: High retention is a misleading signal — it masks the collapse in new client intake.

evidence_items.finding: Surface signal (not root cause): the three accountants are at current capacity, which the owner interprets as a sign of health
evidence_items.rationale: Capacity utilisation is a misleading stability signal — capacity is being consumed by existing clients, not sustained by new intake.

metric_key_mappings.transform_note: new_clients_this_year=4 used directly as newCustomerRate (annual intake collapsed from 18 to 4)

validation_notes: HOL-04-001 is a referral-pipeline-collapse demand generation failure case. All findings derived from input_packet. No must_identify vocabulary used. newCustomerRate set to 4 from new_clients_this_year.
